description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.

compare.without: Fills the reply with jargon you can't follow.
compare.with: Restates the last message with no jargon.

compare.without: Rewords it at the same length.
compare.with: Makes it simpler and more concise.
Speaks coherently, like one person talking to another.

brief.intro: It has the AI restate its last message without jargon, simpler and shorter, like one person talking to another.

lessons.title: Point at the text to redo
lessons.does: It just says its last reply again in other words and doesn't start new work.
lessons.why: Naming the target, "your last message", up front means the AI doesn't guess which part you mean.
lessons.try: Point at what to redo: "Say the second paragraph of your last reply again."

lessons.quote: State it more simply and concisely
lessons.quoteTr: State it more simply and concisely
lessons.title: Use the original as the yardstick
lessons.does: The new version is shorter and easier than the old one, not just reworded.
lessons.why: With the last message as the reference, "simpler" has something to measure against.
lessons.try: Compare against the original: "Half as long as the last version, same meaning."

lessons.quote: like one human talking to another
lessons.quoteTr: like one human talking to another
lessons.title: Pick a scene for the voice
lessons.does: It stops sounding like a report and sounds like a colleague explaining next to you.
lessons.why: A conversation everyone knows is easier to imitate than an adjective like "plainer".
lessons.try: Give a scene for tone: "Explain this error the way you'd explain it to a non-technical relative."

blocks: Restate your last message. Stop using jargon and speak coherently. State it more simply and concisely, like one human talking to another.
